'''Aine 25 (April 9)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[999 NE]] - [[Mat]] wakes up in the [[White Tower]] after being [[Healed]] and separated from the [[Shadar Logoth]] dagger. [[Lanfear]], under the guise of Selene, visits him.
*[[999 NE]] - [[Egwene]] and [[Elayne]] are tested and raised as [[Accepted]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] meets with who he thinks is the [[Seanchan]]'s [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]], who turns out to be [[Semirhage]] in disguise. Semirhage destroys Rand's left hand but is then captured.
*[[1000 NE]] Mat launches an attack on Seanchan camps and ambushers their lancers in [[Molvaine Gap]].
